end.summary:
Explored “unity in diversity” and “many in the one.”
Compared Pongal and Lohri through foods, customs, seasons and shared values.
Gave examples of language, dress, food and festivals across Indian regions.
Identified shared threads such as family, respect, helping others and belonging.
end.parentNote: Riya practised comparing different cultural examples and then finding the shared ideas beneath them. They explained several examples correctly, including Pongal and Lohri, regional dress, languages and festivals. They briefly wondered whether differences might cause conflict, then connected diversity with shared celebration, respect, helping and belonging. At home, ask them to compare two festivals or foods using “different in…” and “same in…” sentences.
